tasks.subject: Task 1: Database — user_settings table, anonymous RLS policies, grants
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A user can have a `share_enabled` flag, and when it's true, an unauthenticated Data API request can read (only) that user's `items`, `wishlist_items`, `item_links`, and `item_documents` rows.

**Files:**
- Modify: `db/schema.ts`
- Create: `db/migrations/00XX_*.sql` (auto-generated by drizzle-kit)
- Create: `db/migrations/00XX_share_grants.sql` (hand-written, custom)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `user_settings` table exists with RLS enabled, readable/writable only by its own owner (authenticated role).
- [ ] `items`, `wishlist_items`, `item_links`, `item_documents` each have a second SELECT policy for the anonymous role, gated on `user_settings.share_enabled`.
- [ ] The anonymous Postgres role has an explicit GRANT SELECT on those 4 tables.
- [ ] Verified against a real (temporary) row: with `share_enabled = true`, an anonymous curl request to the Data API can read that user's items; with it false, zero rows.

**Verify:** `npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate` applies cleanly; anonymous curl test against a real toggled row confirms both states.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["db/schema.ts", "db/migrations/"], "verifyCommand": "npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate", "acceptanceCriteria": ["user_settings table exists with owner-only RLS", "items/wishlist_items/item_links/item_documents have anonymous select policy gated on share_enabled", "anonymous role has explicit GRANT SELECT on those 4 tables", "anonymous curl returns rows when share_enabled=true and empty array when false"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: useSharedCollection composable
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A composable that fetches a specific target user's items, wishlist items, links, and documents by explicit userId — without touching useItems()/useWishlist()'s global useState caches.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/composables/useSharedCollection.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Fetching items/wishlist for a user with sharing disabled returns an empty array, not an error.
- [ ] None of this composable's state uses the same useState keys as useItems() (`items:list`) or useWishlist() (`wishlist:list`).
- [ ] Reuses existing row-mapping functions (fromRow, fromLinkRow, fromDocumentRow, fromWishlistRow).

**Verify:** `npx tsc -b --force` clean.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/composables/useSharedCollection.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc -b --force", "acceptanceCriteria": ["composable uses userId-namespaced useState keys, not items:list/wishlist:list", "reuses existing fromRow/fromLinkRow/fromDocumentRow/fromWishlistRow mappers", "tsc clean"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Settings page — toggle + copyable share link
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A logged-in user can turn sharing on/off for their own account and get their share link.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/composables/useShareSettings.ts`
- Create: `app/pages/settings.vue`
- Modify: `app/components/Masthead.vue`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Visiting /settings while logged out redirects to sign-in.
- [ ] Toggling on persists share_enabled=true and immediately shows the share link with a working copy button.
- [ ] Toggling off persists share_enabled=false and hides the link.
- [ ] First-time visit (no user_settings row yet) shows the toggle off, not an error.
- [ ] "Settings" appears next to "Sign Out", only when logged in.

**Verify:** `npx tsc -b --force && npm test` clean; live browser toggle test.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/composables/useShareSettings.ts", "app/pages/settings.vue", "app/components/Masthead.vue"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc -b --force && npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["toggle persists share_enabled to user_settings", "share link + copy button shown only when enabled", "first-time visit shows off state without error", "Settings link next to Sign Out, only when logged in"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Share-host routing middleware + minimal layout
tasks.description:
**Goal:** share.corvettepositraction.com/<uuid> resolves to the share page tree; the existing login-redirect middleware never fires for share paths; share pages render in a minimal layout with no private nav.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/middleware/share-host.global.ts`
- Modify: `app/middleware/auth.global.ts`
- Create: `app/layouts/share.vue`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] /share/<uuid> works directly on the main domain, no hostname trick needed.
- [ ] share. hostname + bare /<uuid> path rewrites to /share/<uuid>.
- [ ] /share/* never redirects to /auth/sign-in when logged out.
- [ ] Auth bypass on the share. hostname is independent of middleware execution order.

**Verify:** `npx tsc -b --force` clean.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/middleware/share-host.global.ts", "app/middleware/auth.global.ts", "app/layouts/share.vue"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc -b --force", "acceptanceCriteria": ["/share/<uuid> works directly on main domain with no hostname trick", "share. hostname + bare /<uuid> path rewrites to /share/<uuid>", "auth middleware bypasses /share paths and share. hostname independently of rewrite order", "share layout has no SectionTabs"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Share landing page (Collection + Wishlist grids)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** share.corvettepositraction.com/<uuid> shows that user's Collection and Wishlist, read-only, or a generic "not public" message if sharing is off / the user doesn't exist.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/pages/share/[userId]/index.vue`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] With sharing enabled, shows real items/wishlist using EditorialCard styling.
- [ ] With sharing disabled or a random UUID, shows one generic message — never distinguishes the two cases.
- [ ] No Edit/Add/Remove controls.
- [ ] Item clicks navigate to correct /share sub-routes.

**Verify:** `npx tsc -b --force` clean; live incognito-browser test against a real enabled/disabled toggle.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/pages/share/[userId]/index.vue"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc -b --force", "acceptanceCriteria": ["real shared data renders read-only for a logged-out visitor", "disabled/nonexistent uuid shows identical generic message", "no edit/add/remove controls present", "item clicks navigate to correct share sub-routes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
